messages:
Lena: Opening a small PR to add a migration note: some users are seeing KV-prefetch not helping when switching to aggressive quant profiles (e.g., q8-highmem). I want to document the root cause and recommended steps. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/8591
Cory: Oof yes we've seen that. TL;DR: quantization can change layout & memory so prefetch heuristics misestimate working set and you get more cache misses. Good idea to document.
Jules: Can we include a tiny flow: 1) detect symptom (more cache_miss metric + higher token latency), 2) quick mitigations, 3) long term: adjust quant profile or increase prefetch window.
Lena: Draft mitigation checklist I plan to add:
- check metric `redwood.kv_prefetch_miss_rate` > 0.1
- check `redwood.batch_effective_size` drop vs baseline
- try switching to `q8-balanced` or `q4_0` to compare memory footprint
- if OOMs, set Batching.MaxBatchMs=0 for streaming endpoints or reduce max_batch_size
Cory: Please add example commands to query metrics via the console API so users can copy/paste.
Lena: Good call. Example curl I'll add:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  "https://console.redwood.ai/api/metrics?name=kv_prefetch_miss_rate&range=15m" | jq .
```
Nina: Also include a short JS snippet showing how to opt out of KV prefetch per-request (customers want per-route control):
```js
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-3', input, prefetch: { enabled: false } });
```
Jules: Nice. Might be worth a short note about testing locally on smaller GPUs: add a paragraph "run perf-check.sh with --quant q8-highmem and record baseline".
Lena: I'll add a one-liner perf script call. Also planning a tiny regression test in examples/ci that fails if token stream stalls for >200ms with MaxBatchMs=8.
Infra: Heads up: the internal infra docs link for quant profile names moved last week. Could docs-bot run the link-checker after the PR?
docs-bot: @Lena scheduled link-check + snippet-lint when PR opens. Will report back.
Cory: One editorial preference: avoid "high-memory" wording; use the exact profile id (q8-highmem) and explain tradeoffs briefly.
Lena: Yep will use exact ids and add a table: profile | mem footprint | expected batch impact.
Nina: Small UX ask: add a short note under "Troubleshooting" that suggests toggling prefetch off for 5-10 minutes and observing error rates before changing model profiles. That helped a customer avoid unnecessary model reverts.
Lena: Great anecdote, adding it. ETA for PR: tomorrow morning PST. Will ping for reviews. :v
